dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, progressive 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse greyish vertical shading patterns observed on the lateral-dorsal surfaces flanking the central axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the primary white surface and the low-contrast greyish shaded areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast dark spots localized on the posterior dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined central longitudinal dorsal ridge exhibiting a sharp contrast gradient compared to the adjacent lateral planes.
